name: claude-workflow-kit
description: nil-park's personal Claude Code workflow skills, managed via GitOps.

plugins.name: workflow-core
plugins.description: Standalone, dev-environment-neutral skills: coding and docs standards, a write-review work cycle, a scratch-dir convention, and a pre-push guard.

plugins.name: git-workflow
plugins.description: Branch + PR/MR delivery driven by the gh or glab CLI. Depends on workflow-core.

plugins.name: ko-style
plugins.description: A Stop hook that flags English-calqued Korean in files the turn just edited. Independent of the other plugins.

plugins.name: project-skills-bootstrap
plugins.description: Installs work-cycle, coding-standards, and docs-standards as project-level skills under .agents/skills/, with .claude/skills/ symlinks.
